category_title: Students with or at-risk for Emotional and Behavioral Disorders (EBD) exhibiting disruptive and off-task behaviors
minimal_context: The student is working on an assigned arithmetic worksheet at their desk during general classroom instruction.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please complete the arithmetic problems on your assigned worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at the math problems and raises hand to get teacher attention) I don't know how to do these.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks away from the assigned work and starts texting on a phone) If you don't bother me I won't bother you.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to put that away and finish your assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Wanders out of seat, walks over to another desk, and starts making loud noises while bothering a peer)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please complete the arithmetic problems on your assigned worksheet.

STUDENT: (Looks at the math problems and raises hand to get teacher attention) I don't know how to do these.

TUTOR: Just keep working on it.

STUDENT: (Looks away from the assigned work and starts texting on a phone) If you don't bother me I won't bother you.

TUTOR: You need to put that away and finish your assignment.

STUDENT: (Wanders out of seat, walks over to another desk, and starts making loud noises while bothering a peer)
